summary: newcleo plc, a UK-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on October 5, 2026, containing an October 2, 2026 press release and unaudited condensed interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine first-half earnings release, not a special situation, though it retrospectively notes the completed September 21, 2026 de-SPAC business combination with NewHold Investment Corp III, which generated approximately $247 million gross proceeds (about $31 million trust release plus $216 million PIPE). Ordinary shares and warrants trade on Nasdaq under NWCL and NWCLW; 281,534,950 ordinary shares outstanding at closing.
